answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 36151 Country: India Title: Is it necessary for men to cover our body from navel to below the knees with cloth while performing ghusl, if yes, then when and how it should be done? Question: Is it necessary for men to cover our body from navel to below the knees with cloth while performing ghusl, if yes, then when and how it should be done? Answer ID: 36151 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 70/53/H=1433) If he is performing ghusl in open place then it is necessary, otherwise not. And it is better to have bath covering the satr parts in bathroom too. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
